english.title: Display a flag / banner / emblem likely to cause a breach of the peace - Manchester Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) displayed a

(A)_[flag,]_
(B)_[banner,]_
(C)_[emblem,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY CONTENT OF FLAG, BANNER OR EMBLEM..), which, in the opinion of a constable or airport official,

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 3.35 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
